svg.data-what: a coronal section of the brain, seen from the front through the thalami: the right side of the body is on the left of the picture

path.data-what: the brain stem, cut across below the thalami
the cerebral cortex, the grey ribbon folded around both hemispheres, the temporal lobes hanging at the sides
the white matter: bundles of myelinated fibres under the cortex
the internal capsule on the right side: the fibres between the cortex and the brain stem, passing between the deep nuclei
the putamen on the right side, outer part of the basal ganglia that shape movement
the globus pallidus on the right side, the paler inner part of the lentiform nucleus
the thalamus on the right side, relay of the senses to the cortex
the lateral ventricle on the right side, a cavity of cerebrospinal fluid, with its temporal horn low in the temporal lobe
the caudate nucleus on the right side, bulging into the lateral ventricle: basal ganglia
the hippocampus on the right side, curled in the inner temporal lobe: forming new memories
the internal capsule on the left side: the fibres between the cortex and the brain stem, passing between the deep nuclei
the putamen on the left side, outer part of the basal ganglia that shape movement
the globus pallidus on the left side, the paler inner part of the lentiform nucleus
the thalamus on the left side, relay of the senses to the cortex
the lateral ventricle on the left side, a cavity of cerebrospinal fluid, with its temporal horn low in the temporal lobe
the caudate nucleus on the left side, bulging into the lateral ventricle: basal ganglia
the hippocampus on the left side, curled in the inner temporal lobe: forming new memories
the third ventricle, the slit of fluid between the two thalami
the septum pellucidum, the thin wall between the two lateral ventricles
the corpus callosum, the bridge of fibres crossing between the hemispheres
